somos: Specialists in pumping solutions for fire protection systems. We know that the fire pump is the heart of the system: it is what keeps the water moving, ensures pressure and flow, and guarantees that, at the critical moment, the entire system responds efficiently.

We supply fire pump sets and other safety equipment built to the highest standards of quality and technology. Our mission is to provide complete, reliable and innovative solutions, tailored to the needs of each customer. We achieve this by combining a team of dedicated specialists, reliable suppliers, standardized quality processes and equipment fully compliant with national and international regulations.

solucoes.x: Pump sets are ideal for applications with existing infrastructure or that require installation flexibility. They allow integration in the field, providing versatility and lower initial costs.

Skid systems integrate all the components of a pump house on a single metal base, ready and factory-tested. This approach reduces assembly time, ensuring quality and reliability and reducing the need for specialized labor.

The container solution is an evolution of the pump house: an enclosed system, designed and tested at the factory. Ready for operation, it offers maximum protection to the equipment and can be installed quickly, even in remote locations or where infrastructure is limited.

notasSeq: Our welding services are performed in accordance with AWS D1.1 for steel structures; ASME Section VIII, Division 1 for the fabrication of metal tanks; and ASME B31.1 and ASME B31.3 for industrial piping systems.
The pump sets comply with {norma}, {certificacao}.
The pump curves are defined in accordance with NFPA 20.
The maximum pressure at shut-off is limited to 140% of the rated pressure.
[diesel] The selection of the diesel engine takes into account the power derating due to altitude, in accordance with NFPA 20.
[diesel] The fuel tank is sized in accordance with NFPA 20.
The electrical control panels are designed and manufactured in accordance with NR 10.
Rotating elements are protected by metal guards, in compliance with NR 12.
The hydraulic and electrical interconnection of the Pump House with the customer's network, as well as the installation of the silencer, is excluded from this scope of supply.
Civil works design and the infrastructure required to accommodate the Container, Skid or Pump Set are excluded from this scope of supply.
Approval by the competent environmental authorities is not included.
The supply of a variable frequency drive is excluded from our scope.
The air release valve is outside our scope of supply. If the pump type offered is End Suction, according to the criteria of NFPA 20, its use is not required.

The alignment and leveling of the pump set, between driver and pump, are performed at the LS Fire factory and subsequently checked on site by the LS Fire technician, after installation by the customer or the responsible installer.
Spare parts for assembly, commissioning and start-up are not applicable.
The LS Fire standard warranty applies.
Any item not clearly described in our proposal is excluded from our scope of supply.
[start-up] Commissioning and Start-up included.

observacoesServico: SERVICES WARRANTY – 90 DAYS: The services warranty will be 90 (ninety) days, limited to workmanship defects demonstrably attributable to LS Fire;

ADDITIONAL DAY RATES: The proposal covers only the day rates provided for in the scope. If the technician needs to remain beyond the contracted period, the additional day rates will be charged separately, at R$ 4.000,00 (four thousand reais) per day rate, plus any additional expenses;

WORKING HOURS: The services will be performed during business hours, Monday to Friday, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., with a 1 (one) hour lunch break. Work performed outside this period must be authorized in advance and may incur additional costs;

ACCESS AND WORKING CONDITIONS: The contracting party shall provide safe access to the equipment, adequate conditions for performing the services and, when necessary, local support for the technical team;

ADDITIONAL SERVICES / PROBLEMS IDENTIFIED: Any service not provided for in the scope, including repairs, replacement of components or additional activities identified during execution, will be reported in advance to the contracting party and quoted separately;

PRE-EXISTING CONDITIONS: LS Fire is not responsible for pre-existing problems, interference by third parties or installation conditions that prevent or hinder the performance of the services as initially planned;

TRAVEL, LODGING AND MEALS: The technicians' travel, lodging and meal expenses are covered within the period and conditions provided for in the scope. If it becomes necessary to extend the technical team's stay for reasons not attributable to LS Fire, the resulting additional expenses will be charged separately;

WARRANTY LIMITATIONS: The services warranty does not cover failures arising from interventions by third parties, subsequent changes to the installation, improper operation of the equipment or lack of adequate maintenance.
